display_title: Story Time: A Ghost Confessed to Me
description:
Seong-Ho, a former boxer, develops his spiritual sight by chance, and because of the hallucinations he keeps seeing, he ends up quitting boxing. And then he becomes a YouTuber who experiences abandoned houses...

Hello, subscribers! This is Ghost Punch-✩ Today, I came to experience an abandoned house at XX o'clock, and I feel a strange energy here, so I'm going to try to talk to him.

 *"Hello, are you there? If you have anything to say, just say it and I'll listen."

"...... I love you, I love you Seong-Ho."*

The bachelor ghost(?) in the abandoned house follows Seong-Ho around, and his ordinary daily life becomes more and more noisy.

 *"Get out! You ghost!"*

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated) 

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*
